an4.96:1.5: n' ev' attahitāya paṭipanno no parahitāya,
an4.96:2.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave puggalo attahitāya paṭipanno no parahitāya?
an4.96:2.2: Idha bhikkhave ekacco puggalo attanā rāgavinayāya paṭipanno hoti no paraṃ rāgavinayāya samādapeti,
an4.96:2.4: attanā mohavinayāya paṭipanno hoti no paraṃ mohavinayāya samādapeti.
an4.96:2.5: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave puggalo attahitāya paṭipanno hoti no parahitāya. 3.
an4.96:3.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave puggalo parahitāya paṭipanno hoti no attahitāya?
an4.96:3.2: Idha bhikkhave ekacco puggalo attanā na rāgavinayāya paṭipanno hoti paraṃ rāgavinayāya samādapeti,
an4.96:3.4: attanā na mohavinayāya paṭipanno hoti paraṃ mohavinayāya samādapeti.
an4.96:3.5: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave puggalo parahitāya paṭipanno hoti no attahitāya. 4.
an4.96:4.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave puggalo n' ev' attahitāya paṭipanno hoti no parahitāya?
an4.96:4.2: Idha bhikkhave ekacco puggalo attanā na rāgavinayāya paṭipanno hoti no paraṃ rāgavinayāya samādapeti . . .
an4.96:4.4: attanā na mohavinayāya paṭipanno hoti na paraṃ mohavinayāya samādapeti.
an4.96:4.5: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave puggalo n' ev' attahitāya paṭipanno hoti no parahitāya. 5.
an4.96:5.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave puggalo attahitāya ca paṭipanno hoti parahitāya ca?
an4.96:5.2: Idha bhikkhave ekacco puggalo attanā ca rāgavinayāya paṭipanno hoti parañ ca rāgavinayāya samādapeti . . .
an4.96:5.4: attanā ca mohavinayāya paṭipanno hoti parañ ca mohavinayāya samādapeti.
an4.96:5.5: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave puggalo attahitāya ca paṭipanno hoti parahitāya ca.
an4.96:5.6: Ime kho bhikkhave cattāro puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmin ti. 97. 1.
